svg.metadata: {"analysis_kind": "descriptive_visualization", "analysis_version": "0.1.0", "attribution_url": "https://himalayas.app", "dataset_kind": "development_sample", "guardrails": ["descriptive keyword evidence only: every metric is derived from the deterministic keyword baseline applied to the development sample; no embeddings, LLMs, semantic search, or fuzzy inference were used", "not correlation: cooccurrence counts how often two skills appear in the same records; it does not measure any relationship, association, or dependency between skills", "not causality: no metric here claims that one skill causes, predicts, or is required by another", "not market coverage: the analysis covers exactly 20 records from one page (limit=20, offset=0) of one source (Himalayas), marked complete: false; it is not a market snapshot and no whole-market claim is made", "not representative: this single-page sample of one job board is not representative of the Ecuadorian labor market or of any broader job market", "no_evidence vs zero matches: no_evidence records are records where the taxonomy found no keyword at all; a taxonomy skill with zero matches in this sample is not evidence that jobs lack that skill"], "matcher_version": "keyword-baseline-0.1.0", "sample": {"complete": false, "limit": 20, "offset": 0, "page": 1, "records": 20, "total_count": 94520, "warning": "development_sample: exactly 20 records from one bounded page (limit=20, offset=0), snapshot cap_0370798f7af4b0e3, taxonomy technical-skills-0.1.0, complete: false \u2014 this is not a full feed and not market coverage"}, "snapshot_id": "cap_0370798f7af4b0e3", "source": "himalayas", "streamlit_status": "pending \u2014 the interactive Streamlit demo is not implemented; these offline artifacts are the baseline visualizations", "taxonomy_version": "technical-skills-0.1.0"}
